mcqs.question: Where and when was the third indigenous Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC) “Mangrol” inducted into the Indian Navy?
options: At Naval Dockyard, Mumbai, on 12 October 2026
At Naval Dockyard, Mumbai, on 7 April 2004
At Cochin Shipyard, Kochi, on 12 October 2026
At Naval Dockyard, Visakhapatnam, on 12 October 2026
mcqs.explanation: Mangrol, the third indigenous ASW-SWC built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd, was inducted at Naval Dockyard, Mumbai, on 12 October 2026. The date 7 April 2004 refers to the end of service of the earlier minesweeper INS Mangrol, while Kochi and Visakhapatnam are associated with Cochin Shipyard and the Eastern Naval Command, respectively.
